tagline: The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily emb
description:
The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure crepe silk saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

Fabric: Pure Crepe Silk

Colour: Aqua Green

Embroidery Colour: Ivory

Unstitched Blouse: Included (image)

Embroidery Type: Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

Wash Care: Dry Clean

tagline: The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embr
description:
The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicolored floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

description:
The Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure georgette saree with all over shadow work chikankari embroidery. A beautiful delicate parsi gara embroidery runs all over the border of the saree and pallu. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

tagline: The Parsi Gara is a cherished part of Parsi heritage and has long been included in a bride's trousseau. Traditionally passed down from mother to daughter, these beautifully embroidered pieces are treasured as family heirlooms and continue t
description:
The Parsi Gara is a cherished part of Parsi heritage and has long been included in a bride's trousseau. Traditionally passed down from mother to daughter, these beautifully embroidered pieces are treasured as family heirlooms and continue to be loved by younger generations.

Parsi Gara embroidery reached its peak between the early 1900s and 1930s. Inspired by nature and cultural influences, classic motifs include floral vines, cranes, phoenixes, fish, and intricate botanical patterns, each reflecting the artistry of skilled craftsmen.

This Burgundy Floral Parsi Gara Dupatta is entirely hand embroidered by experienced artisans using traditional techniques. Featuring an elegant floral jaal spread across the dupatta, every stitch is carefully handcrafted, making each piece unique. Designed to complement festive, wedding, and special occasion outfits, it is a timeless addition to any ethnic wardrobe.

Fabric: Pure Georgette 2.5 meters

Base Colour: Navy

Embroidery Colour: Multicolour

Embroidery Pattern : Floral

Technique :  Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

Wash Care :  Dry-clean

tagline: A pure crepe silk saree in peach shade carrying multicolour Parsi Gara embroidery worked entirely by hand. The motifs are floral, drawn from a craft tradition once reserved for Parsi trousseaus and passed down through generations of embroid
description:
A pure crepe silk saree in peach shade carrying multicolour Parsi Gara embroidery worked entirely by hand. The motifs are floral, drawn from a craft tradition once reserved for Parsi trousseaus and passed down through generations of embroiderers along India's western coast.

Every thread on this saree traces back to a technique that nearly disappeared as fashion moved away from handwork in the decades after the 1980s. What survives today is rare, and each piece carries the imprint of the artisan who made it, no two are ever quite the same.

The saree is finished with careful attention to facings and edges, and comes with a matching one-metre unstitched blouse piece, its sleeve ends finished in the same Parsi Gara embroidery.

Fabric: Pure Crepe Silk
Base Colour: Peach
Embroidery: Multicolour Parsi Gara, Floral motif
Blouse: 1 metre unstitched, embroidered sleeve ends
Care: Dry clean only

name: Burgundy Floral Parsi Gara Dupatta
imageAlt: Burgundy Floral Parsi Gara Dupatta
tagline: The Parsi Gara is a cherished part of Parsi heritage and has long been included in a bride's trousseau. Traditionally passed down from mother to daughter, these beautifully embroidered pieces are treasured as family heirlooms and continue t
description:
The Parsi Gara is a cherished part of Parsi heritage and has long been included in a bride's trousseau. Traditionally passed down from mother to daughter, these beautifully embroidered pieces are treasured as family heirlooms and continue to be loved by younger generations.

Parsi Gara embroidery reached its peak between the early 1900s and 1930s. Inspired by nature and cultural influences, classic motifs include floral vines, cranes, phoenixes, fish, and intricate botanical patterns, each reflecting the artistry of skilled craftsmen.

This Burgundy Floral Parsi Gara Dupatta is entirely hand embroidered by experienced artisans using traditional techniques. Featuring an elegant floral jaal spread across the dupatta, every stitch is carefully handcrafted, making each piece unique. Designed to complement festive, wedding, and special occasion outfits, it is a timeless addition to any ethnic wardrobe.

Fabric: Pure Georgette 2.5 meters

Base Colour: Burgundy

Embroidery Colour: Multicolour

Embroidery Pattern : Floral

Technique :  Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

Wash Care :  Dry-clean

description:
The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral embroidered jaal all over. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara..

tagline: The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embr
description:
The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicoloured floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

Colour: Lilac

Embroidery Colour: Multicolour

Embroidery Pattern: Floral 

Unstitched Blouse: Included (image)

description:
A pure georgette dupatta in soft lavender, bordered with hand embroidered Parsi Gara work and finished with small sprinkled motifs through the body. Parsi Gara is often called painting in thread, a technique brought to India through centuries of trade between Chinese artisans and Parsi families, now carried forward by a small number of karigars.

The embroidery here takes its cues from nature, floral sprays and birds worked in multicolour thread against the lavender base. Each motif is placed by hand, so no two dupattas carry the embroidery in quite the same way.

This is pure georgette border work dupatta with small sprinkled motifs all over.

description:
Please note that this is pre order Parsi gara saree and will take 3-4 months to deliver.

The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicolored floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

name: Designer Navy Parsi Gara Pure Georgette Saree
imageAlt: Designer Navy Parsi Gara Pure Georgette Saree
tagline: The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embr
description:
The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicolored floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

Fabric: Pure Georgette 60 grams

Colour: Navy

Embroidery Colour: Multicolour

Embroidery Pattern: Floral & Birds

Unstitched Blouse: Included (image)

Embroidery Type: Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

Wash Care: Dry Clean

description:
The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a green Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral embroidered jaal all over. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure georgette border pallu saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
DELIVERY TIME: 4 MONTHS

The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicolored floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

description:
Please note: This Parsi Gara dupatta is available on pre-order. Delivery will take approximately 2–3 months.

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers. This is a light grey Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral and birds embroidered motifs all over. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna. 

This is a pure georgette saree with all over chikankari embroidery. A beautiful delicate french knot embroidery runs all over the border of the saree and pallu. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
Please note: This Parsi Gara dupatta is available on pre-order. Delivery will take approximately 2–3 months.

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a black Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral embroidered jaal all over.  These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

Beautiful dupattas are an indispensable part of a lady’s wardrobe. Walk with elan and exude the traditional ethnic beauty in our gorgeous hand crafted dupattas.

The timeless elegance of a traditional Parsi Gara  is undeniable.

description:
Please Note: This is Pre Order Parsi Gara Dupatta and will take 3 months time to deliver.

Delve into the rich heritage of the Parsi tradition with our exquisite Parsi Gara Hand Embroidered Dupatta. Rooted in centuries-old customs, the Gara holds a special place in a Parsi bride's trousseau, symbolizing the enduring bond between generations as it passes from mother to daughter, cherished and preserved for years to come.

Even in modern times, the allure of the Gara remains strong among millennials and Gen Z Parsis, who appreciate its timeless beauty and cultural significance. Fashion experts highlight its golden era, spanning from the early 1910s to the 1930s, when motifs like the phoenix, cranes, and fish adorned fabrics alongside ornamental flowers, showcasing the artistry and craftsmanship of the era.

Our Parsi Gara Hand Embroidered Dupatta pays homage to this illustrious tradition, meticulously crafted by highly skilled artisans. Each floral embroidered jaal is a testament to their expertise, resulting in a surreal masterpiece that captivates the senses and honors the legacy of the Parsi Gara embroidery.

Embrace the elegance and heritage of the Parsi Gara with this timeless piece, destined to become a treasured heirloom in your collection.

Embroidery Colour: Multicolor

Technique : Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

description:
Please note : This is a pre order saree and will take 3-4 months to deliver 

The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure crepe silk. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicoloured floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

NOTE: Model image is for representation purpose only. Please see the close up images for actual embroidery.

tagline: The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embr
description:
The Parsi 'gara' saree, an exquisite fusion of embroidery, artistry, and cultural heritage, is a testament to the creativity and elegance of Parsi women. These women, known for their enterprising spirit, ingeniously transformed heavily embroidered swatches into stunning saris, seamlessly blending Indian tradition with Parsi style. The term 'gara' originates from the Gujarati word for saree, and the embroidery, deeply rooted in Parsi art, gives rise to the enchanting Parsi gara.

This particular saree, a border pallu masterpiece, showcases exclusive Parsi gara hand embroidery on pure Georgette fabric, weighing 60 grams. The delicate Baby Pink hue adds a touch of grace to the ensemble, while the hand-embroidered multicolored floral, bird, and flamingo motifs depict the rich influence of flora and fauna in Parsi culture.

Included with the saree is an unstitched blouse piece, allowing for custom tailoring to complement individual preferences. The meticulous hand Parsi gara embroidery adds a touch of authenticity and craftsmanship to this timeless piece. To preserve its intricate beauty, it is recommended to dry clean this saree, ensuring it remains a cherished symbol of Parsi artistry and tradition.

Fabric: Pure Crepe Silk

Colour: Ferozi Blue

Embroidery Colour: Multicolour

Embroidery Pattern: Floral & Birds Figures

Unstitched Blouse: Included (image)

Embroidery Type: Hand Parsi Gara Embroidery

Wash Care: Dry Clean

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

description:
Please Note : This is Pre Order Parsi Gara Dupatta and will take 3-4 months time to Deliver

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

 

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral with birds embroidered jaal all over.  These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
The   Parsi Gara embroidery is mainly  Indian embroidery with a Persian heritage. It is famously called "Painting in threads". Buying a   Parsi   Gara   is like purchasing jewellery, which can be handed down to the next generation as an heirloom.   The  Parsi  embroidery can be traced back to 650AD where Persian women undertook the Indian style of clothing. 

Fusion of multicolour embroidery with golden mukaish/kamdani makes this saree so   aesthetically appealing   as to make all eyes turn. Unstitched blouse piece included as per image.

description:
A pure crepe silk saree in lemon yellow, carrying multicolour Parsi Gara embroidery worked entirely by hand. The motifs are floral, drawn from a craft tradition once reserved for Parsi trousseaus and passed down through generations of embroiderers along India's western coast.

Every thread on this saree traces back to a technique that nearly disappeared as fashion moved away from handwork in the decades after the 1980s. What survives today is rare, and each piece carries the imprint of the artisan who made it, no two are ever quite the same.

The saree is finished with careful attention to facings and edges, and comes with a matching one-metre unstitched blouse piece, its sleeve ends finished in the same Parsi Gara embroidery.

description:
The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure crepe silk border pallu saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
DELIVERY TIME: 4-5 months

Parsi Gara  work is a symbol of embroidered work at the helm of beauty of its kind. It is heirloom not just by way of words but in true spirit of the marvel it is. While wearing a gara to a wedding was still popular until the 80s, it began to go out of fashion as young people took to western wear. However, it is getting a fresh lease of life with the Parsi gara saris getting a makeover.

This is a black saree with multicolour parsi gara hand embroidery. The embroidery pattern consist of floral and peacock patterns  . The saree is finely finished with facings and edges. The saree comes with an unstitched matched blouse piece with Parsi Gara embroidered sleeve ends.

Colour:  Black

Embroidery Colour:  Multicolour

Blouse Fabric : 1meter Unstitched (as per image)

Wash Care:   Dry Clean

Beautiful Parsi work dupattas are an indispensable part of a lady’s wardrobe. Walk with elan and exude the traditional ethnic beauty in our gorgeous hand crafted dupattas.

Parsi Gara is an intricate embroidered pattern and is famously known as ‘Painting in thread’. The timeless elegance of a traditional Parsi Gara  is undeniable. 

This is a black Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral embroidered jaal all over. M ost patterns in the parsi gara embroidery are are influenced by flora, and scenes and stories of Chinese origin. Geometric designs are rarely used. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
A beautiful peach  chikankari suit with beads multicolour chikankari work on neckline and paisley design on daaman. The dupatta has delicate beads work on sides and motifs.

An organza suit with pearl and Chikankari work is a traditional Indian outfit that is made from lightweight and sheer fabric called organza. The suit typically consists of a long top (kameez), and a scarf (dupatta) that is draped over the shoulders.

The organza fabric used in the suit is usually adorned with intricate Chikankari embroidery, which is a style of hand embroidery that originated in Lucknow, India. This type of embroidery is characterized by delicate floral and paisley patterns that are worked onto the fabric using white cotton thread.

In addition to the Chikankari work, the suit is also embellished with small pearls that are intricately embroidered onto the fabric. These pearls add a touch of glamour and sophistication to the outfit, making it perfect for formal occasions such as weddings, receptions, and other cultural events.

Overall, an organza suit with pearl and Chikankari work is a beautiful and elegant outfit that showcases the rich cultural heritage of India. It is a perfect blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern design, making it a timeless classic that never goes out of style

description:
The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a Parsi work  embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous humans figures , birds and animal embroidered jaal all over.  These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
This is a Pre Order Dupatta and will take 5-6 months to make and deliver.

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral with birds embroidered jaal all over.  These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
This is pre order parsi gara dupatta. DELIVERY TIME: 3 MONTHS.

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a black Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral with birds embroidered jaal all over.  These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
This is a Pre Order Dupatta and will take 4 months to deliver.

The Gara, an age-old Parsi tradition, goes into a Parsi bride’s trousseau. It is passed from a mother to a daughter and preserved for generations. Even today, millennials and Gen Z Parsis love wearing a Gara.

According to fashion experts, the Parsi gara enjoyed its golden period roughly between 1910 and 1930s. Some of the most popular embroideries were the phoenix and the cranes. Fish was another popular motif. Fabrics also sported designs such as ornamental flowers.

This is a black Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral with birds embroidered jaal all over. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

tagline: The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily emb
description:
The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure georgette saree with all over shadow work chikankari embroidery. A beautiful delicate parsi gara embroidery runs all over the border of the saree and pallu. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
It is a pre-order parsi gara saree and will be dispatched in 5-6 months time from your order date.

The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure crepe saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

Colour: Deep Maroon

description:
Please Note:  This is a pre-order for the Parsi Gara saree , with an estimated delivery time of 3 to 4 months.

The Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure georgette saree with all over shadow work chikankari embroidery. A beautiful delicate french knot embroidery runs all over the border of the saree and pallu. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure crepe border pallu saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

Wash Care:   DryClean

description:
Beautiful dupattas are an indispensable part of a lady’s wardrobe. Walk with elan and exude the traditional ethnic beauty in our gorgeous hand crafted dupattas.

Parsi Gara is an intricate embroidered pattern and is famously known as ‘Painting in thread’.

The timeless elegance of a traditional Parsi Gara  is undeniable. 

This is a maroon Parsi Gara embroidery fully hand crafted dupatta. This dupatta has gorgeous floral with birds embroidered jaal all over. M ost patterns in the parsi gara embroidery are are influenced by flora, birds and scenes and stories of Chinese origin. Geometric designs are rarely used. These are fully hand embroidered by highly skilled artisans to make a surreal masterpiece.

description:
This is on Pre-order and takes 5-6 months to make and deliver.

The  Parsi  ' gara ' is a quintessence of embroidery, art and history. No less enterprising than the men, the  Parsi  women, who had already adapted the Indian sari as their attire and wore it in their inimitable style, used the heavily embroidered swatches to turn them into saris. 

'Gara' is the Gujarati word for saree   and as the embroidery was inspired by the parsi art, hence parsi gara. The motifs are influenced by the flora and fauna.

This is a pure crepe border pallu saree with exclusive parsi gara hand embroidery. It comes with an unstitched blouse piece which can be custom stitched.

description:
Introducing our stunning Red Pure Georgette Dupatta with Golden Mukaish Work, a gorgeous addition to your ethnic wardrobe. Made from high-quality, lightweight georgette fabric, this dupatta is perfect for adding a pop of color and sophistication to any outfit.

The beautiful golden Mukaish work adds an elegant touch to the vibrant red fabric, making it a great choice for weddings, parties, and other special occasions. The intricate embellishments catch the light and shimmer with every movement, making this dupatta a real showstopper.

Measuring approximately 2.6 meters in length and 1.2 meter in width, this generously sized dupatta can be draped in a variety of ways. Whether worn over the head, draped around the shoulders, or wrapped around the neck, it adds a touch of luxury to any outfit.

Invest in our Red Pure Georgette Dupatta with Golden Mukaish Work and experience the beauty of traditional craftsmanship combined with modern design. It's the perfect way to elevate any ethnic outfit and stand out from the crowd.
